cohort: Pregnant women with gestational diabetes between 22-34 weeks of gestation.
finding: Adding grapefruit juice to metformin treatment in women with gestational diabetes resulted in better glycemic control and improved neonatal outcomes compared to metformin alone.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was higher in the metformin and grapefruit juice group (3.1 +/- 0.25 kg) compared to the metformin only group (3 +/- 0.23 kg).
